display_long_description:
TierraXR Insulation Training is an educational virtual reality application for learning thermal insulation techniques in façades, suspended ceilings, and under-roofs. It includes three practical VR exercises with realistic procedures, tools, materials, and safety measures.

Designed for training centers, it supports multi-user mode by institution, with separate profiles for teachers and students. Teachers can access live student sessions, guide them, correct mistakes, and use scene replicas to explain procedures before practice begins.

It features a workshop scene where users can freely explore all materials, tools, and PPE, and where students can ask questions to the AI assistant—a conversational expert always available.

It also includes an advanced virtual classroom with 360° scenes, drawing tools, 3D model loading, and the ability to present training content. Everything is managed through an educational intranet that handles sessions, users, and learning progress.

Thanks to its immersive, collaborative, and practice-oriented approach, TierraXR offers a unique experience for training insulation professionals with the support of virtual reality and artificial intelligence.
